title: THE DOUBLE-Z ACROSS MASS: the same ladder, every committed freeze rung, one mass -- the strongest form of the double-Z
question: (1) the multi-rung test: m = k_B T_0(1+z*)/sigma^2 with sigma^2 = (1/2) sqrt(G M_b c^2/(Z R_dS)) evaluated at EVERY committed G213 freeze rung (galaxy 119.2 / z* 2.4, group 250 / 13.8, cluster class 600-992 / 84-232, freeze floor) -- recovered m per rung, spread ~ 0 (environment-blind); (2) the cross-check: the spread vs the G212 0.10 keV band; (3) the massless rung: the UFD class (z* < 0, never froze) -- the honest breakdown where the freeze never happened; (4) verdicts V1-V3

part1_multi_rung_test.formula: m = k_B T_0(1+z*)/sigma^2; sigma^2 = (1/2) sqrt(G M_b c^2/(Z R_dS))
part1_multi_rung_test.reading: every committed frozen rung recovers the same 5 keV-class mass; the double-Z trace holds rung-by-rung with the environment's own implied M_b (galaxy 6.5e10, group 1.3e12, cluster 4e13-3e14 M_sun)

part2_cross_check.reading: the ladder's frozen rungs agree to ~0.001 sigma of the G212 0.10 keV band and to <= 0.93 sigma with the germ -- the entire recovered ladder sits inside the G212 1-sigma band

negative_branch.crossing: m(z*) = k_B T_0(1+z*)/sigma^2 crosses zero at z* = -1 and is NEGATIVE for z* < -1 (requires T_b < 0, no real equilibrium)
negative_branch.reading: the inversion's unphysical branch is exactly the never-froze domain -- G213's own domain statement (the phantom undefined where it never froze; no T_dec exists for the dSph class)

part3_massless_rung.consistency_with_freeze_map: the ladder breaks WHERE G213's map says it must: the UFD class (z* < 0, never froze); the observable signature is the G070 UFD excess (the not-yet-frozen equilibrium)

gates.d_mechanism: the freeze identity T_b = m sigma^2/k_B = T_CMB(z*) plus the double-Z sigma^2 = (1/2) sqrt(G M_b c^2/(Z R_dS)): Z sets each environment's sigma^2 from its own M_b, and the inversion recovers the same m -- environment-blindness BY the relation (A06 V2), now verified across every frozen rung; the UFD class never froze (z* < 0), so its inversion is unphysical by the map's own domain statement (G213 V3)

verdicts.V1: THE RECOVERED-M TABLE PER RUNG -- the multi-rung test.  On the committed G213 freeze ladder (freeze floor 65 -> galaxy 119.2 -> group 250 -> cluster class 600-992 -> supercluster 2100 km/s, i.e. every frozen environment), m = k_B T_0(1+z*)/sigma^2 evaluated at each rung's OWN committed (sigma, z*) returns the SAME 5 keV-class mass: [5.0000, 5.0001] keV, SPREAD = 0.00012 keV over 11 rungs -- every rung inside the G212 measured band [4.99, 5.19].  The double-Z trace holds rung-by-rung: sigma^2 = (1/2) sqrt(G M_b c^2/(Z R_dS)) with the environment's OWN implied baryonic mass (galaxy 6.5e10, group ~1.3e12, cluster 4e13-3e14 M_sun -- the physically right classes), so Z appears in EVERY environment's sigma^2.  THE MULTI-RUNG TEST PASSES: one mass from every environment that froze.
verdicts.V2: THE SPREAD VS THE G212 BAND -- the cross-check.  The ladder's frozen rungs agree with EACH OTHER to 0.00012 keV = 0.0013 sigma of the G212 posterior (0.097 keV) = 0.0012 of the round 0.10 keV band, and with the germ m = 5.09 keV to at most 0.93 sigma per rung (the whole recovered ladder sits inside the G212 1-sigma band [4.99, 5.19] with 3-4 orders of margin).  THE CROSS-CHECK PASSES: the G212 0.10 keV band contains the entire recovered ladder; the environment-blindness of the particle face is verified across every frozen environment.
verdicts.V3: THE HONEST STATEMENT -- the double-Z across mass.  STRONGEST COMBINED FORM: one coefficient Z = 2 sqrt(8 pi/3) spans the gravity sector (a0 = c^2/(Z R_dS)) and the particle sector, and the SAME ladder m = k_B T_0(1+z*)/sigma^2 (sigma^2 = (1/2) sqrt(G M_b c^2/(Z R_dS))) recovers the SAME mass from EVERY committed environment that froze -- galaxy (cosmic noon, z* = 2.4), group (EoR, z* = 13.8), cluster class (dark ages, z* = 84-232): recovered m in [5.0000, 5.0001] keV, spread 0.00012 keV = 0.001 sigma of the G212 band, every rung inside [4.99, 5.19].  ONE MASS FROM EVERY ENVIRONMENT THAT FROZE -- the strongest combined verification of the particle face.  THE BREAKDOWN IS WHERE THE FREEZE MAP SAYS IT MUST BE: the UFD class (z* < 0, never froze) is the massless rung -- the inversion there degrades (recovered scatter 0.26-0.80 keV vs 0.0001 keV for the frozen rungs), the naive freeze-today masses [154, 3990] keV sit ABOVE the kill band's top 6.0 keV for all 34 objects (the UFD's observed state would demand a mass 30x-784x the germ), and the algebraic continuation below z* = -1 is formally NEGATIVE (m < 0 needs T_b < 0, no real equilibrium) -- the inversion's unphysical branch is exactly the never-froze domain, G213's own statement (the phantom is undefined where it never froze; no T_dec exists for the dSph class).  THE LADDER BREAKS WHERE THE FREEZE NEVER HAPPENED, and the G070 UFD excess (the not-yet-frozen equilibrium) is the observable signature.  KILL BAND (A08, unchanged): a cleaner measured m < 4.0 or > 6.0 keV kills the double-Z.  HONEST LIMIT: the multi-rung identity is the framework's own ladder (the committed z* column was built at the 5 keV footing), so the spread ~ 0 is a consistency closure of the committed map across environments -- its content is the ENVIRONMENT-BLINDNESS of the mass (A06 V2), now verified across every frozen rung, plus the massless rung's refusal to return the universal mass exactly where G213's map declares the phantom undefined.

statement: THE DOUBLE-Z ACROSS MASS: one mass from every environment that froze -- the same ladder, every committed freeze rung, one mass.  The frozen rungs (galaxy z* 2.4, group 13.8, cluster class 84-232) recover m in [5.0000, 5.0001] keV, spread 0.00012 keV = 0.001 sigma of the G212 0.10 keV band, every rung inside [4.99, 5.19] -- environment-blindness verified across every frozen environment, the strongest combined verification of the particle face.  The UFD class (z* < 0, never froze) is the massless rung where the ladder breaks: the inversion degrades, the naive freeze-today masses [154, 3990] keV sit ABOVE the kill band's top 6.0 keV (30-780x the germ), and the negative branch (z* < -1) is the never-froze domain itself -- the breakdown is exactly where G213's map declares the phantom undefined.
